The real ATIS is the FAA's digital ATIS (atis.info) in the US; elsewhere it's the ATIS of a VATSIM controller on at the airport, when there is one (its runways and approaches; the weather is the real METAR's). The METAR is aviationweather.gov's; only the airport codes are sent. Once you're at or near an airport, the weather the sim has there wins over any real-world report, so ATC never gives you conditions you aren't flying in; the ATIS says when the two differ. Each ATIS shows where it's from and how old it is. Takes effect on the next flight.
